snippet.title: [Sonny Boy AMV] rhapsody
snippet.description:
❝if there were a place that shone brighter than the place you're at, would you wanna go to it or would you stay where you are and just keep staring at it ?❞


Made for Ethereal IC: RUNWAY.

After so many years of editing, it's probably the first time that I edited exclusively for myself — no collab, no MEP, no commission —  and I've gotta say, it feels intimidating. I wanted to pay tribute to an anime that I'm very attached to while pouring out the things that I like, even for a short amount of time. The more I learn about Sonny Boy, the more I come to appreciate it — and considering how multi-layered the writing is, I wanted to give my own interpretation of the show, and especially the relationship between the two main characters, within the vastness of its worldbuilding.

Shoutout to my teammate @Damis_AMV  for sitting on call with me the whole time. Check out his video here ! https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x5jybNmIcdM

And shoutout to my friends who show enthusiasm whenever I yap about AMVs even though they have no clue wtf I'm talking about. You guys are the best.

Thank you for reading this far, and I hope that it will provide you as much comfort as it did for me.

Music: Radiohead - Weird Fishes/Arpeggi
Source: Sonny Boy + Various
DL : https://shorturl.at/l1Utn
